items.title: PARAMOUNT, the First Randomized Trial of AI-Enabled Plaque-Based Care, Meets Primary Endpoint in Late-Breaking Results at AHA 2026
items.excerpt: Plaque-guided care improved diagnostic certainty and increased use of preventive therapy compared with usual care in patients with suspected coronary artery disease
items.rationale: First randomized trial of AI plaque-guided coronary care meets its primary endpoint at AHA 2026, moving AI-CCTA from detection claims to RCT-backed management changes.

items.title: FDA Grants Breakthrough Device Designation to Cleo Skin AI Pathology Tool
items.excerpt: FDA grants Breakthrough Device Designation to Primaa's Cleo Skin AI pathology tool, which now has both CE-IVDR and FDA status.
items.rationale: Regulatory milestone: an AI dermatopathology tool for melanoma diagnosis gets FDA Breakthrough designation on top of CE-IVDR.

items.title: 한국형 '의약품 AI 심사 보조 시스템' 12월 베일 벗는다
items.excerpt: 식약처가 추진해 온 의약품 AI 심사 보조 시스템이 12월 초 정식 공개된다. 내부 검증을 강화한 뒤 제약업계 대상 설명회를 열 계획이다.
items.rationale: Regulator-side AI: Korea's MFDS unveils its AI drug-review assistant in early December, changing how approval dossiers are screened.

items.title: Patient info improperly used in radiology AI research, academic institution says
items.excerpt: Weill Cornell Medicine says it first found out about the incident on Sept. 6, immediately launching an investigation to determine what happened.
items.rationale: Patient-privacy incident: Weill Cornell discloses patient data was improperly used in radiology AI research, a governance warning for every imaging-AI project.

items.title: Sunderland project using AI to help eye tests detect diabetes
items.excerpt: Researchers hope the technology will allow for a quicker diagnosis for patients.
items.rationale: Front-line deployment: a Sunderland project uses AI in routine eye tests to flag diabetes earlier for patients.
